description: Combined per-ASIN review-mining summary: totals, rating distribution, monthly trend, top complaint topics, most-endorsed complaints, and billing as returned. When the ASIN matches the documented Oct 12, 2026 baseline (B0FQFB8FMG), the report also cites that historical baseline for reference, clearly labeled as historical — never as current data.
